title: Sparkwing node protocol: log record
description: One line of the NDJSON log stream a node process writes to stdout. Each line is one JSON object terminated by a newline. A property whose description starts with 'Target:' is part of the contract the engine-hosted model needs and no SDK emits yet; every other property is emitted today.

ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with fractional seconds. The host may replace it with its own receive time.

node.description: Id of the node that wrote the record.

step.description: Id of the active step, when one is running.

event.description: Empty or absent for a plain message. Known values a node writes: node_annotation, node_summary, step_start, step_end, step_skipped, work_fail_fast, exec_start, exec_line, and the Target exec_end. The engine writes further values of its own, such as node_start, node_end and retry.

msg.description: The message. May carry raw ANSI from a child process; the other fields never do.

level.description: Target: the annotation's severity; absent means notice.

file.description: Target: repository-relative path the annotation points at.

end_line.description: Target: last line of the range in file.

execEnd.description: Target: attrs of an exec_end record, the per-command resource numbers an SDK reports when it has them.

max_rss.description: Peak resident set size in bytes.
